name: camunda-skills
description: Official Camunda skills for AI-assisted Camunda 8 development

plugins.name: camunda-skills
plugins.description: Camunda 8 development skills — c8ctl CLI setup, BPMN modeling, FEEL expressions, forms, connectors, process management, and AI agents

plugins.name: bpmn-studio
plugins.description: Design, lint, view and test Camunda 8 BPMN processes in the chat: interactive bpmn.io modeler (MCP App), Camunda lint rules and an in-memory test engine. Runs @camunda8/bpmn-studio via npx (Node 20+).

plugins.name: camunda-cluster
plugins.description: Work with a running Camunda 8 cluster from the chat: incidents, process instances, user tasks and variables (Orchestration Cluster MCP Server), and deployed processes as tools (Processes MCP Server). Runs c8ctl mcp-proxy via npx (Node 20+); uses your c8ctl profile.
